2105-5895-6968-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-5895-6968-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-5895-6968-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Splash Portal from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Splash Portal from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Splash Portal, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

2226-4713-6751.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more artifacts.
2226-4713-6751.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-4713-6751.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Starfield Vocalist.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Lumengrid Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Lumengrid Drake enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

1479-2841-4201-8293.easyPrerequisites:
You're able to play a land this turn.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Cabaretti Courtyard.
1479-2841-4201-8293.description:
Fetch a land using Cabaretti Courtyard.
When the fetched land enters, Cleveland Booker and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Cleveland Booker trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Cleveland Booker trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Cleveland Booker triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

618-1916-2438.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Changeling Titan.
When the Changeling Titan token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Changeling Titan token.
When the Changeling Titan token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

339-677-6965-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
339-677-6965-7272.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

792-883-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
792-883-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent, Totentanz and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Totentanz ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

295-4613-8227.easyPrerequisites:
Loot doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Viscid Lemures is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
295-4613-8227.description:
Activate Loot using Viscid Lemures' ability by paying {0}, giving Loot -1/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Deal combat damage with Loot. Due to its static effect, it will treat its power as positive when assigning combat damage.

3508-4879-6331.easyPrerequisites:
Stiltzkin does not have summoning sickness.
There is at least one card in your library.
You control a destructible land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
3508-4879-6331.description:
Activate Stiltzkin by paying {2} and tapping it, drawing a card and causing target opponent to gain control of Price of Glory.
During an opponent's turn, activate any land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Price of Glory triggers, destroying the land.
Sacred Ground triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1531-2760-4279.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1531-2760-4279.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature that will trigger Deathgreeter when it dies.
There is at least one additional creature on the battlefield.
1531-2760-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Deathgreeter triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any other creature and causing you to draw a card.
If the creature who had the counter placed has 0 toughness, it dies as a state-based action.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat until your opponents do not control any more creatures, or until you draw your library.
If you have cards remaining in your library, you may repeat this combo any time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1818-1981-2292-2415.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1818-1981-2292-2415.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

757-2174-5904.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by paying {U} and tapping it, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Adric by paying {2}{U} and tapping it, copying Magosi's ability.
Resolve both instances of Magosi's ability, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Play Magosi.
Move to your second extra turn. The first extra turn will be skipped due to the ability activated in step 1.
Repeat.

261-2308-4871-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
261-2308-4871-5231.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters, Suture Priest triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {R}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Suture Priest trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

3490-6723-6965-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-6723-6965-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

3025-4771-5220-6900.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

81-662-1978.description:
Cause Kami of Whispered Hopes to become an artifact using Liquimetal Coating.
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Repeat from step 2.

2866-3518-4986-5256.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2060-3771-4518-6930.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2060-3771-4518-6930.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {W}.
Animar and Spider-Man India trigger.
Resolve the Animar trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Spider-Man India trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.
2060-3771-4518-6930.notes: You may begin the combo with no counters on Animar if you supply an additional {1}.

2510-4484-4871-5643-6798.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
2510-4484-4871-5643-6798.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2510-4484-4871-5643-6798.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Umbral Collar Zealot abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2510-4484-4871-5643-6798.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

3197-4017-6097.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-4017-6097.description:
Gain life.
Sunbond triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

914-4477-5530.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-4477-5530.description:
Cast Another Round by paying {2}{W}, blinking Dockside Extortionist and Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Dockside Extortionist and Greenwarden of Murasa enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Another Round from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.
914-4477-5530.notes: If opponents control four or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

1636-3143-4981.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token with base power 2 or less.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a removable counter on a permanent you control.
1636-3143-4981.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a copy of a creature token you control with base power 2 or less.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Serra Redeemer trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Serra Redeemer trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on the creature token.
Repeat.

2757-3327-3967.notablePrerequisites:
You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
You control a basic Mountain.
2757-3327-3967.description:
Activate a basic Mountain, adding {R}.
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Dargo, untapping a basic Mountain.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

457-851-1409.description:
Activate Urza by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Urza enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Urza.
Resolve the Urza trigger, creating two 0/0 Construct artifact creature tokens.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping the Constructs, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

1283-2816-4916.notablePrerequisites:
Animate Artifact and Umbral Mantle attached to Chromatic Orrery.
Chromatic Orrery does not have summoning sickness.
1283-2816-4916.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Chromatic Orrery by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability.

864-1741-1987-2397.notablePrerequisites: You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
864-1741-1987-2397.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Eternal Witness and Cloud of Faeries.
When Eternal Witness and Cloud of Faeries enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger twice each.
Resolve the first Eternal Witness trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second Eternal Witness trigger, returning any other instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Cloud of Faeries trigger, untapping up to two lands.
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Resolve the second Cloud of Faeries trigger, untapping up to two lands.
Repeat.

1409-2792.easyPrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator paired with Great Whale.
1409-2792.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1409-2792.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Great Whale by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Great Whale.
Repeat.
1409-2792.notes: If up to seven lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.

2024-3842-5168.notablePrerequisites: Bloom Tender does not have summoning sickness.
2024-3842-5168.description:
Cast Planewide Celebration by paying {5}{G}{G}, creating at least one 2/2 Citizen creature token that's all colors.
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Seedcradle Witch by paying {2}{W}{G}, giving Bloom Tender +3/+3 until end of turn and untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
